# AgenticDriver dependency

This archive is built with `npm pack` from `hashimkarim/agenticdriver` commit
`dbe847c07030dd84f9ff7682e1de6d85bbf27d52` on `sdk-roadmap` (MIT).
SHA-256: `ea7db7c4076e5937e0aedaa021cefcf7d8b68c073512ebb22860aace146d4151`.

It contains the compiled SDK, declarations, protocol and license. Dependency
installation does not require a sibling SDK checkout. Registry publication is
tracked separately in AgenticDriver AD-042.
